subject: general
question: Who was the first Vice-President of India to be elected as President by second preference count of votes in the presidential elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VV Giri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Varahagiri Venkata Giri **was the **first Vice-President of India** to be elected as President by second preference count of votes in the presidential elections.
 
• He was an Indian politician and activist who served as** India's fourth president from August 24, 1969, to August 24, 1974,** and as the country's **third vice president from May 13, 1967, to May 3, 1969.**
 
• He was the first and only president elected as an independent candidate.
 
• In 1974, Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed took over as president. Giri was awarded the Bharat Ratna by the Indian government in 1975 after serving his full tenure.
 
• On May 13, 1967, Giri was elected India's third vice president, a position he maintained for over two years, until May 3, 1969.
 
• Giri was the third vice president to be elected to the President and the first vice president to not complete his entire term in office due to being raised to the presidency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kocheril Raman Narayanan **was India's tenth president and ninth vice president.
 
• **Ramaswamy Venkataraman **was an Indian lawyer, political activist, and Union Minister who served as India's eighth president.
 
• From 1992 to 1997, **Shankar Dayal Sharma **was India's ninth president.
